base:
Create an ORIGINAL production albedo texture atlas for a dark fantasy knight 3D model. This is a flat 2D texture asset, NOT a picture of a knight and NOT a concept render. Square opaque atlas, exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows of equally sized square texture panels filling the canvas. No text, no labels, no margins or separators. Crisp deliberately placed pixel clusters, handcrafted retro pixel painting at roughly 256x256 pixels over the entire atlas then enlarged nearest-neighbor. Muted desaturated cool blue steel, warm bone ivory fabric, aged brass and oxblood leather. Consistent neutral ambient illumination, NO cast shadows or white glossy render highlights. Fine wear concentrated at edges, quiet middles, do not put random white noise everywhere.
Each panel is a flat UV surface facing directly at the viewer; never draw a complete equipment object or a body:
row1 col1: blue-grey breastplate surface, subtle symmetrical vertical steel fluting with dark center seam and engraved small original three-branch thorn emblem near upper center; col2: backplate, restrained steel with articulated horizontal seams; col3: sallet helmet steel surface with subtle central ridge and fine rivet seams; col4: curved steel shoulder armor surface with overlapping chevron plate trim.
row2 col1: greave steel panel with narrow vertical flutes and edge scratches; col2: gauntlet and vambrace steel panel, rivet rows and narrow articulation lines; col3: shield face painted deep blue-green wood with small bone-ivory branching thorn sigil, no frame, no perspective; col4: weathered aged brass metal trim swatch.
row3 col1: full square bone ivory cape linen, vertical folded weave and narrow burgundy embroidered hem at bottom; col2: bone ivory tunic with narrow dark red vertical decorative band; col3: dark burgundy leather with stitched seam; col4: very dark grey chainmail, tiny staggered legible ring pattern.
row4 col1: dark boot leather, grain and stitch edging; col2: steel blade brushed longitudinal pattern, darker middle and bright edges, no handle; col3: plain blue steel with very restrained brush marks; col4: subdued dark blue-green cloth, tiny weave.
All panels tile or extend right to their bounds; all original art without logos or copied franchise motifs. Exact regular 4x4 layout is essential for UV addressing.
revision: EDIT this atlas. Preserve its EXACT 4x4 panel layout and the original thorn insignia, colors and materials. It is much too photorealistic. Repaint EVERY panel as STRICT hand-crafted low-resolution pixel art with visibly large hard square clusters. Imagine the entire atlas is only 256x256 pixels (64x64 pixels per panel), then nearest-neighbor enlarged. Maximum 32 colors in the entire atlas. Eliminate ALL photographic grain, subpixel lines, smooth gradients, tiny white speckles, strong baked reflections. Each metal seam must be 2 to 3 chunky pixels, scratches sparse thick deliberate strokes, chainmail simple 4-pixel repeating ring marks, cloth broad blocks of flat ivory with 2-tone thread patterns, embroidery chunky stepped pixel pattern, brass three tones only. Steel primarily mid muted bluegrey, highlights very restrained. Solid opaque texture atlas, no borders or text, flat even light. This must look like a usable 1990s hand-painted pixel texture asset not a realistic material render.
status: AI-assisted painted candidate, not hand-pixelled final art
